tagline: Attach Loom video context to Jira tickets for faster issue resolution
metaTitle: Jira + Loom Integration: Loom Bug Reports to Jira Tickets
metaDescription: Turn Loom bug recordings into Jira tickets and attach requirement walkthroughs to stories. GAIA keeps video on tickets. See the setup steps.
intro:
Tickets that describe complex bugs or nuanced requirements in text alone often lead to back-and-forth clarification threads that slow down resolution. A brief Loom recording demonstrating a bug or walking through a feature requirement communicates in seconds what paragraphs of text struggle to convey — but connecting that recording to the right Jira ticket requires manual effort.

GAIA automates the link between the two. Bug recordings create tickets with the video embedded. Recordings referencing an issue ID are automatically attached to that ticket as a comment. Sprint demo recordings are attached to the completed issues they cover, creating a permanent video audit trail of delivered features.

For enterprise teams managing complex backlogs where issue clarity directly affects resolution speed, video context reduces the clarification cycle dramatically and keeps async collaboration productive.

useCases.title: Bug recording to Jira ticket
useCases.description: When a tester records a Loom demonstrating a bug, GAIA creates a bug ticket with the video embedded as the issue description, complete with steps to reproduce extracted from the transcript.

useCases.title: Requirement walkthrough attached to stories
useCases.description: Product managers record walkthroughs of new feature requirements and GAIA attaches them to the corresponding stories so engineers have rich context without a synchronous meeting.

useCases.title: Sprint demo recordings on completed issues
useCases.description: After a sprint review, GAIA attaches the demo recording to each issue demonstrated, creating a permanent video record of what was delivered that stakeholders can review asynchronously.

useCases.title: Design change walkthroughs on in-progress tickets
useCases.description: When a designer records a video showing a design change on an in-progress ticket, GAIA attaches it to the ticket and flags the assignee to review before continuing implementation.

useCases.title: Incident post-mortems with video evidence
useCases.description: During incident response, engineers record walkthroughs of the issue and remediation steps. GAIA attaches these recordings to the incident ticket as a post-mortem reference.

howItWorks.step: Connect Jira and Loom to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authenticate your Jira instance and your workspace in GAIA's settings. GAIA uses Loom's API to monitor new recordings and access video transcripts.
Tell GAIA how to match recordings to tickets, by issue ID in the video title, by folder, or by transcript content analysis. Set trigger phrases for auto-creating new tickets.

howItWorks.step: GAIA attaches videos and creates tickets automatically
howItWorks.description: When a new recording matches your rules, GAIA attaches it to the correct ticket or creates a new one, notifying the relevant team member with a link to both the video and the ticket.

faqs.question: Can GAIA create a Jira ticket from a Loom recording without a pre-existing issue?
faqs.answer: Yes. If a video title includes a trigger phrase like 'Bug:' or 'Issue:', GAIA creates a new ticket using the video title as the issue summary and embeds the link in the description.

faqs.question: Does GAIA use the transcript to populate ticket fields?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA processes the transcript to extract a description, steps to reproduce, and acceptance criteria, using this content to populate the ticket's Description and Comments fields.

faqs.question: Does a viewer need an account to open attached videos?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily. Recordings shared via a public or workspace link can be viewed by anyone with the link. GAIA attaches videos using their shared link so ticket viewers can watch them without a login if the video is set to shared-link access.

faqs.question: Can GAIA attach videos to sub-tasks?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can attach links to stories, epics, tasks, sub-tasks, and bugs. This is particularly useful for QA recordings that correspond to specific acceptance criteria tracked as sub-tasks.
